name: Question 12
problem: A particle of mass $4\,\text{kg}$ is attached to a massless spring. The spring constant associated with the spring is $k=10\,{\text{kg/s}}^{2}.$  The particle is also subject to a resistive force that's proportional to the particle's velocity, and has a damping coefficient $c=8\,\text{kg/s}.$  The position of the particle is $y(t)$ (measured in meters), and $t>0$ is the time in seconds.  If the particle moves with damped harmonic motion, what is the governing equation?

Question 12
?

A particle of mass 4kg is attached to a massless spring. The spring constant associated with the spring is k=10kg/s2. The particle is also subject to a resistive force that's proportional to the particle's velocity, and has a damping coefficient c=8kg/s. The position of the particle is y(t) (measured in meters), and t>0 is the time in seconds. If the particle moves with damped harmonic motion, what is the governing equation?

a
y″+52y′+2y=0
b
y″+2y′+52y=0
c
y″+2y′+5y=0
d
y″+5y′+2y=0
e
y″+2y′+10y=0
